question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who eats meat but not seafood or fish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Carnitarian"** refers** to a person who eats meat but not seafood or fish.** (मांसाहारी जो समुद्री भोजन या मछली नहीं खाता)

 
 
• **Example: **John is a **carnitarian**; he enjoys eating beef and chicken but avoids fish and shrimp.
 
 
 
• **"Carnivorous"** refers to an organism that primarily eats meat. (मांसाहारी)
 
 
• **Example: **Lions are **carnivorous** animals that hunt other animals for food.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Herbivorous** (शाकाहारी): An organism that primarily eats plants.

 
 
• **Example: **Cows are** herbivorous** animals that graze on grass.
 
 
 
• **Omnivorous** (सर्वाहारी): An organism that eats both plants and animals.
 
 
• **Example: **Bears are omnivorous and eat both berries and fish.
 
 
 
• **"Carnivorous" **refers to an organism that primarily eats meat. (मांसाहारी)
 
 
• **Example: **Lions are** carnivorous** animals that hunt other animals for food.
